answer: Quarantine means no reward and no jury seat, so a tight farm earns nothing until it builds genuine external links. Because the vertex partition is computed from the nebula history, the canyon audit publishes the cut and the operator cannot claim the cluster was accidental. The funding graph is partitioned each epoch and any partition holding more than 10 identities with no external edges is quarantined as a sybil cluster. That is 36 dollars per alias. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
